secret_rule.rationale: Two stages. pickaxe_regex is a POSIX ERE git evaluates natively to narrow candidates (git log -S --pickaxe-regex, git grep -E); it is a line-level superset of credential_patterns and deliberately interval-free, because bounded repetitions make git's POSIX matcher several times slower over full history. credential_patterns are Python regexes over the whole blob and decide: real credential shapes only, never bare prefixes. PEM blocks need base64 key material after the BEGIN line. Database URLs need a literal password of at least min_length characters that is neither a placeholder ($VAR, {var}, <var>, [var], %s, masked ***) nor a documented local development default. AWS documentation keys ending in EXAMPLE are not credentials. A match holding an ascending run of synthetic_run_length digits or letters is a hand-made fixture. reviewed_blobs exempts individually reviewed content by git blob ID only; any edit is scanned again.
